title: Decision models reach local runtimes
summary: Ollama 0.35.0 adds native decision models for scoring and classification, while uv 0.12.21 refines lockfile output.

items.name: ollama
items.what: Local runtime supporting decision models via a dedicated systemone endpoint.
items.whyDifferent: Returns probabilities and choices rather than text generation for classification tasks.

items.name: uv
items.what: Extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust.
items.whyDifferent: Omits empty manifest tables from lockfiles and updates CPython bundled OpenSSL.

readThrough: Local runtimes now support structured decision routing natively, reducing reliance on heavy text-generation pipelines for simple classification tasks; teams should evaluate it against their own stack, security controls and operating constraints before adoption.

social.linkedin: Local runtimes are expanding beyond simple text generation into structured decision routing. Ollama v0.35.0 introduces native support for decision models through a dedicated endpoint that returns probabilities, scores, and choices instead of prose. For engineering teams evaluating local architectures, this shifts ticket triage, model routing, and content classification away from large language models and onto lightweight classifiers. Meanwhile, Astral released uv 0.12.21, bringing cleaner lockfile generation and updated OpenSSL bindings for CPython.
